openclaw_config_surface.qubit_counterpart: Qubit config system (voicebridge/config.py DEFAULTS + the vendored runtime <QUBIT_HOME>/config.yaml); Qubit runs no OpenClaw process, so the OpenClaw config schema is not a supported product surface and is never silently ignored
openclaw_config_surface.rationale: OpenClaw config paths are out-of-runtime for Qubit; supported Hermes keys are bound per-path and OpenClaw env names are enumerated per-name above. Binding per-path here would invent mappings to a config system with no corresponding Qubit runtime.
